# Matrix (generated by scripts/Registry.lean; do not edit)

Scanned libraries: `AvailableChainRegistry`. The rows are the rows of `docs/REGISTRY.md`.

One line per instance: a constant whose type, after its leading binders, is `Instance` or `StrongInstance`. An instance with parameters (`gridInst p`) has one line, by its constant name. One column per catalog claim, then one column per catalog profile, each by its `id`, in lock order. A row of a pulled claim goes in the column of its base claim. A row of a claim or profile that is not in the catalog has no column.

A cell shows its rows. Only a row with status `LEAN` or `LEAN (family)` gives a result:

- `cert`: a certificate (`cert` or `profile-cert` row).
- `refuted`: a refutation. `refuted-all`: a refutation family.
- `holds`: the claim propositions at one constant; no inhabitation; can be vacuous; not a certificate and not a `Candidate`.
- `holds*`: `holds` from a family row, for every value of its data binder.
- `gap`: a `KNOWN-GAP` row. `cond`: a `CONDITIONAL` row. `gap` and `cond` cells are records, not results; MATRIX consumers ignore them.
- `unsound`: a row with any other status.
- `+` joins the parts of one cell. `·`: no row.
